studies.title: Breadfruit
studies.caption: Large starchy fruits grow among deeply lobed leaves. Pacific growers carried living cuttings between islands to establish new trees.
studies.prompt: Close upward botanical view of Artocarpus altilis branch with very large glossy deeply lobed leaves and two round green breadfruits with finely patterned pebbled skin; one cut fruit on woven mat below showing pale starchy flesh. No giant spiky durian or jackfruit, tropical island hints only.
